segments.title: Pre-Broadcast Audio Configuration
segments.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell troubleshoots audio routing for co-host Fiona before abandoning news format for an Elden Ring character creation session.

segments.title: Elden Ring Character Creation: Notorious Sex Guy Case Blackwell
segments.notes: Chat polls determine character name, class (Samurai), build (Check Guy the Science Eyes/perfumer), age (mature), and visual archetype (Lube Chef) with maximum skin luster, blonde hair, mustache, rosy cheeks, eyeliner, and chocolate facial tattoo.

segments.title: Lands Between Tutorial Playthrough
segments.notes: Blackwell reacquaints with controls, acquires spectral steed Torrent, meets Melina and Witch Ranni, obtains Spirit Calling Bell, and survives a Tree Sentinel encounter before saving progress.

segments.title: Broadcast Conclusion and Host Handoff
segments.notes: Anchor terminates session for Patreon podcast obligation, acknowledges raid from Mogax, and hosts streamer Psychor.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News suspended standard news operations for an extended Elden Ring character creation and tutorial session. Anchor Case Blackwell, declaring 'this isn't news anymore,' collaborated with chat to construct a mature Samurai named Notorious Sex Guy Case Blackwell optimized for a perfumer-based 'science eyes' build, before acquiring Torrent and the Spirit Calling Bell in the opening hours of the Lands Between.
